frames.title: The Choice of Tempo
frames.narration: You stand at a crossroads where two versions of your evening meet: one begins before sunrise with chai and stillness; the other starts at midnight with code and electric focus.

frames.title: Old Delhi Morning
frames.narration: Steam rises from a clay cup as the city wakes. You notice tiny details others miss, and the day opens with a sense of purpose.

frames.title: Rooftop Hacknight
frames.narration: Laptop glow, cool air, and the hum of possibility. You prototype fast, then pause to ask if this build should also move people.

hotspots.label: Enter the chess and chai debate

frames.title: Spice Bazaar Sprint
frames.narration: Color, noise, momentum. You weave through crowds like a strategist under pressure, deciding whether to chase the next frontier or invest in people first.

frames.title: Riverfront Reflection
frames.narration: At the water's edge, the world quiets. You map your next chapter by intuition, discipline, and what actually matters.

frames.title: Garage Jam
frames.narration: Rhythms lock in with friends. You realize your best decisions happen when craft and connection happen in the same room.

frames.title: Chess and Chai Debate
frames.narration: Every move has tradeoffs. You play patiently, listening more than speaking, then choose what kind of impact you want to leave.

frames.title: Ending: Trailblazer
frames.narration: You choose velocity with intent. The result is bold work, visible outcomes, and a path others begin to follow.

frames.title: Ending: Heartline
frames.narration: You choose people-centered leadership. The result is trust, resilient teams, and a life that feels aligned.

frames.title: Ending: Craftsperson
frames.narration: You choose mastery over noise. The result is deep skill, timeless work, and quiet confidence in every step.
